ML model scope.question: What should the ML models actually predict or analyze?
ML model scope.answer: Full analytics ML suite — race predictions + tire degradation curves + sector time pace modeling + championship trajectory

ML model scope.question: What data does the ML model train on?
ML model scope.answer: FastF1 + external datasets (Ergast API, weather correlation, circuit characteristics)

ML model scope.question: Where does ML model training happen?
ML model scope.answer: Offline pre-training, serve artifacts — joblib/pickle serialized models loaded at startup

ML model scope.question: What's the key output of the ML models?
ML model scope.answer: Probability distributions with confidence intervals — e.g. 'Verstappen: 47% win probability ±8%'
options_presented: Both — summary ranking + expandable confidence view

ML model scope.question: How do you want model interpretability shown?
ML model scope.answer: SHAP values per prediction — per-driver SHAP waterfall charts

iOS fate.question: What happens to the iOS app?
iOS fate.answer: Remove iOS entirely — delete the ios/ directory
options_presented: Keep iOS but gut it to a thin shell

iOS fate.question: Confirming removal of ios/ directory
iOS fate.answer: Yes — remove ios/ entirely. Full delete.

iOS fate.question: Should new ML analytics be surfaced on iOS?
iOS fate.answer: No — web-only for analytics. iOS is removed.
